releaseBoundary: These lanes are URPG product-depth follow-through, not bounded v0.1.0 release blockers unless a future release scope promotes them into mandatory exit criteria.

lanes.title: Battle feedback fixture depth
lanes.remainingDepth: Governed FRL-01 battle feedback fixture depth is complete for the current scope.
currentEvidence: battle presentation profile and panel evidence counts
nextImplementation: Keep future battle feedback fixture variants covered by the same import diagnostics and coverage-row contract.
Route newly discovered plugin aliases through the existing normalized policy importer instead of adding parallel policy paths.
Open a new FRL or issue if future battle presentation work expands beyond the completed chip, zero-damage, buff-cap, and troop-position scope.
verificationCommands: ctest --preset dev-all -R "BattleRuleResolver|battle presentation|Compat fixture import: battle feedback" --output-on-failure

lanes.title: State/message/picture fixture import depth
nextImplementation: Add fixture imports for scoped banks, self/map/JS variables, nested escapes, and picture task triggers.
Preserve unsupported picture/state rows with diagnostics.
Add high-count picture fixture snapshots.

lanes.title: Progression visual controls
nextImplementation: Add panel-visible pool, class/actor, increment/decrement, cap warning, and post-load apply controls.
Expose creator-facing disabled reasons and control snapshots.
Cover cap blocking and apply/already-applied rows.

lanes.title: Ability task-graph runtime sequencing
lanes.remainingDepth: Full task-graph runtime sequencing and arbitrary scripting remain.
nextImplementation: Implement deterministic runtime sequencing for authored task graphs with task cursor, wait state, branch transitions, effects, and cue playback.
Keep arbitrary scripting behind an explicit unsupported/sandbox status until a safe API is defined.
Add runtime replay and diagnostics rows for each executed task.

lanes.title: Asset promotion and preview depth
lanes.remainingDepth: Broader curated payload promotion and richer generated preview assets remain.
nextImplementation: Add curated bulk-promotion manifests for the next release-safe payload groups.
Generate missing thumbnail/waveform/sequence preview records for promoted payloads.
Add package/readiness diagnostics for missing preview or license evidence.

lanes.title: Painted AI diff rendering
nextImplementation: Render JSON patch rows as painted before/after groups with add/remove/replace tone.
Expose selected diff details and blocked-apply reasons in editor/chatbot snapshots.
Test that painted rows derive from patch data.

lanes.title: Automatic project filesystem walking
nextImplementation: Add bounded filesystem crawler configuration with include/exclude globs, max file count, max bytes, and text allowlist.
Convert walked files into directly ingested knowledge records.
Emit skipped-file diagnostics for ignored, oversized, binary, or excluded files.

lanes.title: Broader AI validator invocation
nextImplementation: Route run_validation through subsystem validators where available.
Record validator source, command, artifact path, severity, and issue rows.
Add fallback diagnostics when a subsystem validator is unavailable.

lanes.title: Socket-level live chat streaming
lanes.remainingDepth: True socket-level live chunk delivery remains.
nextImplementation: Add a socket-backed streaming path that emits chunks as they arrive.
Keep curl/dry-run as deterministic fallback and fixture lane.
Expose chunk timing, partial text, completion, cancellation, and provider error diagnostics.
